title: ApprovalToken 1.0.0 - exact-bound human approval (fail-closed)
description: This is a SHAPE check only: passing it is not an acceptance and never authorizes an action. The law is enforced in src/security/humangate.py and is NOT expressible here - the token must bind exactly to the ApprovalRequest (subject, subject_hash, semantic_version, actor, operation, target_system, resource set, environment, purpose_ref, scope set, data_class, effect_digest, consumer_audience_hash, request_id, decision_id; token.request_id/decision_id must equal the request's, DENY_EXACT_BINDING), the approver/actor must be a human principal ref (prefix human:), issued_at <= commit_time < expires_at, every generation the VerificationContext supplies AND every generation the request declares must match (DENY_STALE_GENERATION), the expected consumer audience hash is mandatory (DENY_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH), approval_basis_hash is RECOMPUTED from the request's six fields (DENY_APPROVAL_BASIS), and the signature must be a REAL Ed25519 verification over DOMAIN_FRAME || RFC8785-JCS(token without signature) against a public key resolved by the injected trusted key registry. RUIN / UNKNOWN_RUIN always refuse. R5: the canonical risk domain is one EffectRiskTier enum (effect_risk_tier = LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL|RUIN|UNKNOWN_RUIN); RUIN/UNKNOWN_RUIN are carried INSIDE it. `ruin_class` does NOT exist in the canonical source and is accepted ONLY as a NON-CANONICAL legacy alias when effect_risk_tier is absent, and it may never weaken a present canonical value. A present-but-malformed permission_class/effect_risk_tier/autonomy_tier fails closed (DOC-03 15.6). A proxy, a syntactic string or a green check can never close this gate.

actor.description: The human principal asserting the operation; runtime requires the human: prefix.

approver.description: The approving human principal ref; runtime requires the human: prefix and refuses any model/tool/provider/agent/mcp/a2a/automation ref.

if06b_version.description: IF-06B ABI version. The runtime requires ABI major 1; any other major is refused with IF06B_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

payload_schema_version.description: Payload schema version emitted by the writer; the runtime reader accepts only 1.0.0 (DENY_TOKEN_SCHEMA otherwise).

min_reader_version.description: Oldest reader ABI allowed to read this token. The runtime reader is 1.0 and refuses a token whose min_reader_version is newer (DENY_TOKEN_SCHEMA).

writer_version.description: Recognised writer revision. An unrecognised writer is a hard failure (DENY_TOKEN_SCHEMA), never a silent downgrade.

compatibility_class.description: Declared compatibility class. An unknown class is a hard failure (DENY_TOKEN_SCHEMA).

evidence_link.description: Non-empty evidence pointer bound to the approval basis; the runtime refuses an empty or non-string value (DENY_TOKEN_SCHEMA).
